# Third-party notices

<!-- GENERATED by `scripts/check-third-party-notices.sh --write` from the Go module
     graph (`go-licenses report ./...`). Do not edit by hand: the License Compliance

The Go modules and packages compiled into the OpenIDX binaries, with the licence
[go-licenses](https://github.com/google/go-licenses) identifies for each. Versions
are in `go.sum`; this list names what ships and under which terms. Each entry links
to the module's licence page on pkg.go.dev. The admin console's npm dependencies
are reported by the same CI job as the `npm-licenses` artifact and are not listed here.
